sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: An identifiable thing the system can talk about.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: A person, tool or organization is a thing; what someone says about it is a separate statement.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: SAP can be an Organization; Joule Studio can be a Technology in an illustrative proposal.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Canonical entities are created or reused when governed assertions are approved.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Stable identity lets multiple statements refer to the same thing.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Identity uses workspace, type and normalized name. This is not fuzzy matching or a general entity-resolution service.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.
